主要内容: FirstEnergy Corp. saw its stock rise to its highest level in nearly a decade following the announcement of a $2.5 billion equity investment by a group that includes Elliott Management Corp. The Akron, Ohio-based utility owner is forming a "restructuring working group" to minimize the time needed to exit the unregulated power business. The company has been considering options such as debt restructuring or bankruptcy protection for its FirstEnergy Solutions unit, which includes a basket of coal-fired and nuclear power plants that have been negatively impacted by the rise of cheap natural gas.
